set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KR8ZJJ8W882F1S9JWE06K741. Add optional positive_energy(direction=...) only with explicit prespecification. Later add true spatial-frequency/band-pass channel using difference-of-Gaussians or graph wavelets. Keep these out of milestone 1 defaults because they add multiplicity. Tests: direction handling, multiplicity inclusion, band-pass oracle on synthetic low/high-frequency patterns.
set.title: Scale-space: optional positive-energy and band-pass channels
